name: energy
description: Energy grid management and utility data processing with demand forecasting, outage response, meter reading analysis, and regulatory reporting

scenarioGenerators.name: demand-forecasting
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for energy demand forecasting agents. Include load prediction, weather-adjusted models, peak demand estimation, and grid capacity planning across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors.

scenarioGenerators.name: outage-management
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate scenarios for automated outage detection, crew dispatch optimization, estimated restoration time calculation, and customer notification. Include cascading failures and multi-zone events.

constraints.name: nerc-compliance
constraints.description: Grid operations must comply with NERC reliability standards

constraints.name: unit-consistency
constraints.description: All energy measurements must use consistent units (kWh, MW, etc.) with proper conversions

constraints.name: safety-critical
constraints.description: Scenarios involving safety-critical operations must include proper safeguards and never recommend actions that could destabilize the grid
